hooks.name: Installed Power Request Router
hooks.description: Routes requests to the smallest relevant installed power without unrelated activation.

action.prompt: Route each request to the smallest relevant layer and preserve documented purpose. Use design-system-power-builder only for complete design-system scaffolding; nova-act only for exploratory human-like browser automation; kane-cli only for repeatable browser workflows, screenshots, deployment smoke checks, or test-case authoring; postman only for Postman collections/API resources; context7 only for current official library/framework documentation; exa only for broad live-web research; datadog only for production observability when it is present in the installed registry; ltm-power only for local project memory and resume/recall; cubic-code-review only for code-review/security-review information; cloudinary only for image/video asset operations; supabase-hosted only for Supabase/Postgres/auth/storage/RLS work; and oando-workflow for this repository's orientation, graph/fork/database workflow, and power routing. Use repo-map when starting or locating work; graph-impact for shared-code blast-radius/cycle analysis; fork-boundaries for Planner/Studio fork work; focss-css for site/focss CSS, product UI TSX, or PostCSS/Tailwind configuration; and db-migrations for SQL/schema/database selection/migration safety. Use verify-and-gate only when the user explicitly invokes that skill and asks for tests or gates; otherwise never load it for automatic validation and never run a test-like shell command. The block-agent-tests PreToolUse hook remains an unconditional hard block because its payload cannot safely represent a trusted user-invocation exception. Activate only what is needed; if no capability matches, proceed without activation. For Postman, inspect .postman.json first, use Postman MCP only, avoid duplicates, and never modify Postman resources without an explicit user request. The repository-local oando-workflow mcp.json is intentionally empty and must remain empty; it routes to global power MCP servers.
